title: Assessing Domain-Level Susceptibility to Emergent Misalignment from Narrow Finetuning
reasoning: The paper evaluates emergent misalignment, which it defines as the deviation from human-established values or objectives. The core evaluation metric is based on alignment with 'human values', and the study includes domains related to social values (e.g., gender roles) and unethical behavior (e.g., providing illegal advice, toxicity).
